## Official Repositories

- **[blyx](https://github.com/Blyx-lang-space/blyx)**: Official Blyx Compiler (`blyxc`), Toolchain, Standard Library (`blyx-std`), and Runtime (`blyx`).
- **[rfcs](https://github.com/Blyx-lang-space/blyx)**: Requests for Comments (RFCs) for language design proposals.
- **[vscode-blyx](https://github.com/Blyx-lang-space/blyx)**: Official VS Code Extension for Blyx.

Official Website: [https://blyx-lang.space](https://blyx-lang.space)
